drawn_objects: long position tool over the early rally on the left: green/teal profit box above a pink/red stop box (entry, target and stop prices not readable — the tool's own labels are not shown at this zoom)

several grey horizontal supply/demand zones (order-block style rectangles), one near the chart top containing a black dashed midline, one mid-chart, one just above the breakdown, and one at the bottom

chart.what_the_drawing_says: BTC has broken down from the ~74.5k area to ~62.1k and is chopping at the lows beneath a dense stack of horizontal levels and grey order-block zones stretching up to ~89k; the black zigzag with an up-arrow at the right edge projects a bounce/rally out of the current ~62k range back toward those levels.

claims: Yes let's go summer gonna be green hold tight
notes: Overlaps IMG_7861 (the 07/07/2026 02:38 messages repeat). In IMG_7861 the second emoji of the 02:38 message was occluded; here it is fully visible as a flexed-biceps 💪, not crossed fingers. Price-axis tag colours were sampled pixel-by-pixel: green (104,173,92), teal (70,150,128), blue (89,183,208), red (222,72,79), grey (128,128,128). One further grey tag sits above 89,027.3 but is cut off by the message-bubble top edge — it reads approximately '89,2??.?' and is NOT recorded. A stray '0' glyph appears to its right (partially rendered tag). The tags are stacked/decluttered by TradingView at uniform vertical spacing, so tag-to-line mapping cannot be derived from position — line colours are reported, not per-line prices. The chart's time axis and the bottom of the chart are cut off by the '#ticket-0514' banner, so visible_date_range is null; the only timestamp on the chart is the crosshair label 'Jul 14, 2026 01:47 UTC+5:30'. The long position tool's entry/target/stop numbers are not readable.
